description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_XHTML, which extends the HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy class. It sets properties related to the XHTML module for HTML Purifier, including its name, default level, and a method to create attribute fixes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_XHTML
classes.description: A class representing the XHTML-specific Tidy module configuration for HTML Purifier, extending the base Tidy module class.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Creates and returns an array of attribute transformations, specifically including a transformation for the 'lang' attribute.
